combined.title: Original shared authorization budget

Total allocation combines the conservative cost upper bound of verified current requests, current unknown and in-flight reservations, and the full prior reservation. It is not a provider invoice. The prior reservation is not released into the current allocation or counted as zero cost; these are not two new authorizations.
combined.policyAll: The original authorization is shared by the conservative upper bound for verified prior requests, full reservations for prior unknown outcomes and the current run cap. Cumulative allocation also includes current verified, unknown and in-flight amounts. It is not a provider invoice; prior allocations are neither refunded nor authorized again.

qaCorpus.title: Real corpus quality evaluation
qaCorpus.intro: Run a versioned real news question bank through current Elasticsearch retrieval, checking each answer against its sources. Report it separately from synthetic regression and the RAG smoke test.
qaCorpus.scope: Questions, expected facts, source fingerprints and news dates are fixed. ES index, mapping, embedding and article content are checked before execution; drift blocks execution or marks results stale. Loading a bank does not establish execution or quality.
qaCorpus.smokeLimit: Synthetic regression detects prompt, tool and model behavior regressions. The existing RAG chain selects one article and runs two turns as a smoke test. The real news bank adds broader answer and source quality coverage; all three complement each other.

qaCorpus.pending: Semantic review pending · quality not determined
qaCorpus.metricScope: Recall measures coverage of this question's fixed expected sources in the union of actual tool retrieval results, not recall across all ES news. MRR averages reciprocal rank per actual retrieval call; each input and returned ranking is retained. Final answer source coverage, retrieval and semantic grounding are reported separately.

qaCorpus.finalSourceLimit: This measures sources listed in final answers, not ES retrieval ranking. A citation does not establish answer grounding.
qaCorpus.qualityLimit: Synthetic structural scores are not combined here. A single-article, two-turn RAG smoke test cannot establish a bank pass. Unexecuted and unreviewed cases remain gaps.
qaCorpus.reviewImportHint: Review JSON must match this report and every case hash, covering all observed cases. Importing does not call ES or paid models.

qaCorpus.answerEvidence: Final source items, citations, post-run reference text and usage
qaCorpus.actualToolTrace: Actual model tool arguments and results
qaCorpus.referenceLimit: Sources contain reference text fetched separately from ES after execution. They do not establish what the model read; use the SDK tool arguments and results for that evidence.
qaCorpus.groundingScope: Grounding must be checked against tool results actually received by the model. Expected facts and post-run full text cannot support claims the model never saw.
qaCorpus.traceIncomplete: Actual tool evidence is missing or truncated, so complete source grounding cannot be established.
qaCorpus.historyMeasurement: Open details for source match and semantic results; excluded from structural test totals.
qaCorpus.historyHint: A versioned real news bank, reported separately from synthetic regression and the RAG smoke test.

indexer.title: Data indexing
indexer.description: Checks indexer behavior with fixed test data. It does not write data into the real news index.

crawler.title: News crawling
crawler.description: Checks crawler parsing and data handling with fixed test data. It does not confirm a live website collection flow.

storage.title: Data persistence
storage.description: Uses fixed data and simulated I/O to check conversation storage, category names, and category merge rules. It does not connect to a real database.

retrieval.title: Retrieval and answers
retrieval.description: Uses fixed data to check retrieval queries, vector interfaces, citations, and scoring guards. It does not establish real model answer quality.

retrievalEvaluator.title: Retrieval evaluation
retrievalEvaluator.description: Uses fixed cases to check the calculations and decisions in retrieval analysis, recall gates, and answer faithfulness scoring tools.

agentBehavior.title: Tools and conversations
agentBehavior.description: Uses fixed cases to check agent scope, data and instruction injection protection, conversation turns, and execution interfaces. It does not call paid models.

trajectoryEvaluator.title: Trajectory evaluation
trajectoryEvaluator.description: Checks agent step scoring with fixed execution records. It does not show that a real model completed a task as intended.

identityAccess.title: Signed-in identity and database access
identityAccess.description: Checks the current user identity, QA index access, and restrictions on production data and administrative permissions.

newsData.title: News, categories, and vector data
newsData.description: Reads real news data to check index fields, vector dimensions and values, and the news API data and category format. It does not measure search relevance.

recordRecommendation.title: Click storage and recommendation response
recordRecommendation.description: Checks that a click is stored with the exact ID assigned to this run, and checks the recommendation API response format. It does not measure recommendation quality.

conversationStorage.title: Store and read back fixed conversations
conversationStorage.description: Stores two turns of fixed content and compares the result read back through the chat API. This is a storage test; no model generates answers.

chatTurn1.title: First model retrieval and answer
chatTurn1.description: Calls the real model to retrieve news and answer, checking stream completion, cited sources, the automated judge, saved answers, and usage evidence. A pass still needs human quality review.

chatTurn2.title: Follow-up model retrieval and answer
chatTurn2.description: Continues the first topic with real model retrieval and an answer, checking citations, the automated judge, turn order, saved answers, and usage evidence. A pass still needs human review.

feedbackHistory.title: Feedback storage and conversation history
feedbackHistory.description: Checks that feedback matches this user, conversation, and second-turn answer, and checks the history list API response format.

cleanup.title: Clean up this run's test data
cleanup.description: Removes only tracked test documents still owned by this user, then checks their removal. Uncertain ownership or write outcomes remain visible as failed evidence.

history.intro: Review recent verification results and complete execution output.
history.retention: Each owner retains the latest 20 validation runs and 5 model evaluations. Run status, reports and full logs are saved automatically on the QA host and restored after restart or container replacement. Reviews are archived separately; download backups for longer retention.
history.searchHint: Search run ID, revision, or model
history.error: Some records could not be updated. Showing the last observed results; refresh to retry.

shell.activeHistory: Another verification is running and its progress has been retained. Finish or cancel it before opening a different run.

qaFlow.chooseTitle: What do you want to verify?
qaFlow.chooseIntro: Choose a goal, configure its scope, then run the checks and review the evidence.
qaFlow.noAutoStart: Choosing a task does not run tests. Review the scope and requirements on the next page.
qaFlow.recentHint: Each task retains its history. Progress tracking continues when you switch pages.
qaFlow.activeNotice: A task is running. Return to it to follow progress.

offline_regression.title: Code regression
offline_regression.description: Check pipelines, retrieval contracts, tools and multi-turn behavior using fixed fixtures.
offline_regression.scope: Run every suite or choose pipelines, RAG or agent behavior. Each step retains its test counts and logs.
offline_regression.limit: Fixed-fixture regression runs in the QA service. It does not verify real ES, live models or human semantic quality.

es_integration.title: Service integration
es_integration.description: Connect isolated real ES and APIs to verify storage, retrieval and cleanup.
es_integration.scope: Follow a fixed plan covering indexing, retrieval, API responses and fixture cleanup, with evidence for each check.
es_integration.limit: Uses isolated test data without paid models. This does not certify answer quality.

real_es_llm_e2e.title: RAG chain
real_es_llm_e2e.description: Select one article from real ES and run two turns to smoke-test the RAG chain.
real_es_llm_e2e.scope: Verify ES → API → models/tools → evaluation. Confirm service requirements, reserved cost and consent first.
real_es_llm_e2e.limit: Uses paid models. A single-article, two-turn smoke test does not establish full real corpus quality.

model_evaluation.title: Model evaluation
model_evaluation.description: Check real model answers and tool behavior in fixed synthetic retrieval scenarios.
model_evaluation.scope: Choose cases and a budget to collect actual answers, tool traces, structural checks, tokens and estimated cost.
model_evaluation.limit: Model calls incur costs. Retrieval data is synthetic with no real ES connection. Human semantic review remains pending.

real_corpus_quality.title: Real corpus quality
real_corpus_quality.description: Run a versioned real news question bank through current Elasticsearch retrieval, checking each answer against its sources. Report it separately from synthetic regression and the RAG smoke test.
real_corpus_quality.scope: Questions, expected facts, source fingerprints and news dates are fixed. ES index, mapping, embedding and article content are checked before execution; drift blocks execution or marks results stale. Loading a bank does not establish execution or quality.
real_corpus_quality.limit: Synthetic structural scores are not combined here. A single-article, two-turn RAG smoke test cannot establish a bank pass. Unexecuted and unreviewed cases remain gaps.

qaFlowLive.answersNote: Read each model response against fixed synthetic retrieval evidence.

qaFlowLive.usageNote: Track observed requests, token usage and the estimated cost of this run.
qaFlowLive.semanticNote: A completed run and structural PASS do not establish answer quality. Review the actual answers and source evidence.
qaFlowLive.notRunNote: No execution record yet. Configure the cases, confirm the cost and start explicitly.

qaSemanticReview.completedNote: The review covers observed cases only. Unexecuted cases, structural failures and revision limits remain. Expand a case below to inspect all four judgments and failure reasons.
qaSemanticReview.importHint: Choose the review JSON for this run. Mismatched reports or row fingerprints are rejected. Importing does not call a model.
qaSemanticReview.archiveHint: Restore the original execution report and review without rerunning a model or incurring model charges.
qaSemanticReview.importedNote: The original revision and outcome are preserved. Importing does not revalidate the current revision.
qaSemanticReview.importError: Review import failed. Check that the file matches this execution and contains complete case ratings, then retry.
qaSemanticReview.fileError: The file is not valid review JSON or exceeds the size limit.
qaSemanticReview.storageError: Review evidence could not be saved. This import has not completed.
qaSemanticReview.failedReview: This semantic review contains failed cases. Fix and revalidate them.
qaSemanticReview.reviewedLimit: The review outcome and reasons have been saved. Use failed cases, unexecuted scope and revision differences to decide the next step.

qaEvaluationScope.title: Evaluation purpose and scope
qaEvaluationScope.summary: Model and agent configuration regression · Synthetic retrieval data
qaEvaluationScope.purpose: Check whether the model can choose tools, cite evidence and answer as requested within QA Workbench's agent setup. Fixed cases help detect regressions after changes.
qaEvaluationScope.subjectNote: The current model together with QA Workbench's instructions, tool definitions and agent execution flow (harness). A single run measures this configuration.
qaEvaluationScope.methodNote: Real model calls use fixed synthetic retrieval data. Cases cover tool selection, time filters, citations, follow-up questions and error recovery.
qaEvaluationScope.resultNote: An automated PASS means that the case's rules passed. Answer accuracy and support from sources still require review of each case.
qaEvaluationScope.limit: This evaluation does not measure retrieval quality on real ES data or cover the complete online service flow. Use RAG full-chain validation for end-to-end checks.

qaFaithfulLive.intro: Check how the model and QA Workbench's agent configuration work together in fixed scenarios.
qaFaithfulLive.modelNote: Fixed synthetic data; no real ES connection.
qaFaithfulLive.acknowledge: I agree this run will incur charges, within the estimated budget above.
qaFaithfulLive.acknowledgeNote: Costs are estimated from usage and published rates, not a hard provider invoice cap; requests may already be in flight when stopping.
qaFaithfulLive.answersNote: Inspect real model responses within the synthetic scenarios.
qaFaithfulLive.tracesNote: Record the model's tool / API calls and their parameters.
qaFaithfulLive.rulesNote: Check case rules for tools and parameters, time filters, citations, required facts and termination, with PASS / FAIL results.
qaFaithfulLive.usageNote: Record actual token usage and calculate the estimated cost of this run.
qaFaithfulLive.semanticTitle: Answer quality still needs case review
qaFaithfulLive.semanticNote: Review whether each answer addresses the question, is accurate and cites sources that support its claims. Automated rules alone do not establish semantic quality.

qaFaithfulValidation.offlineSubtitle: Fixed test fixtures and contract checks · No model cost
qaFaithfulValidation.offlineScope: Real Elasticsearch, real models, and human semantic quality have not been verified in this run.

qaFaithfulFlow.landingIntro: Use structured verification to check RAG, APIs, tools and model integration.
qaFaithfulFlow.chooseHint: Choose the verification that fits your goal. We will guide you through setup and execution.

qaHealth.title: System health
qaHealth.subtitle: Prioritize issues that affect real functionality.
qaHealth.refreshed: Design data reloaded. Observation time stays fixed; no live health check ran.
qaHealth.rulesDescription: Formal scoring rules are not implemented, so no numeric score is shown. Use measurements, thresholds, observation times and coverage. Missing or stale observations are not a pass; service metrics do not certify answer quality.
qaHealth.evidenceHint: Synthetic data for the selected module, used to inspect page elements and evidence presentation. These are not real service results.
qaHealth.chartDescription: Illustrative trend: waiting time rises from 6 to 38 minutes against a 20-minute threshold. Expand the data table for all measurements.
qaHealth.noHistory: No trend preview for this module
qaHealth.noHistoryHint: Missing charts or old observations do not imply a healthy service.
qaHealth.rootCausePending: Insufficient evidence to confirm a root cause.
qaHealth.qualitySeparate: Service health and answer quality are evaluated separately.
qaHealth.unknownNote: Missing or stale data is not a pass.

indexer.title: Latest-news embeddings are delayed
indexer.impact: Recent articles may not yet appear in vector search. Existing articles and keyword search remain available.
indexer.event1: Waiting time observed above 20 minutes; issue detected.
indexer.event2: Latest observation: 38 minutes and still accumulating.

collector.list: No update for 6 min | Last observed 14:26
collector.title: Health observations stopped updating
collector.impact: The collector heartbeat is stale. Its previous observation cannot establish current health; restore monitoring before drawing conclusions.
collector.event1: Two-minute heartbeat threshold exceeded; data marked stale.
collector.event2: No new observations. Previous healthy verdict is not reused.

frontend.title: Frontend is available
frontend.impact: Page and asset probes are healthy in this preview. Availability does not verify every user journey.

agent.title: Agent API is responding
agent.impact: Complete-response success meets the illustrative threshold. Answer content and source quality require a separate review.

es.title: Elasticsearch queries are healthy
es.impact: Query latency is within the illustrative threshold. Data completeness and embedding-model consistency need separate measurements.

crawler.title: Crawler is updating
crawler.impact: The crawl job completed within its expected window. Source coverage and article correctness need separate validation.

llm.list: No call errors in the last 15 min
llm.title: LLM API calls are healthy
llm.impact: Recent calls recorded no errors. This does not certify answer correctness or imply that a quality evaluation ran.

qaHealth.observationNote: No valid current observations for {modules}. Each summary reflects its stated observation time.

evidenceReasons.indexer: The oldest article has waited {value}, above the {threshold} threshold. {pending} articles are pending.
evidenceReasons.collector: The last heartbeat was at {time}: no update for {value}, above the {threshold} threshold. Current state is unconfirmed without new observations.
evidenceReasons.frontend: The page probe took {value}, within the illustrative {threshold} threshold.
evidenceReasons.agent: Complete responses reached {value}, meeting the illustrative {threshold} minimum. Answer quality still needs review.
evidenceReasons.es: Search p95 is {value}, within the illustrative {threshold} threshold.
evidenceReasons.crawler: The last successful crawl was {value} ago, within the illustrative {threshold} threshold.
evidenceReasons.llm: The last 15 minutes recorded {value}, within the illustrative {threshold} threshold. No quality evaluation ran.

live.scope: Scope: this QA instance and mounted shared-ingestion job records.
live.retained: Previous values are retained as stale; earlier healthy verdicts are not reused.
live.expired: Observations expired or their clock is not synchronized. Reload to check again.
live.evidenceHint: Read-only measurements and source timestamps. Missing probes, stale data and failed jobs remain distinct.

errors.invalid: The health payload is invalid; state is unconfirmed.
errors.authentication: Sign in again with an authorized QA account.

impacts.frontend: Checks the public QA entry response, QA page identity and duration. Browser interaction and answer quality require separate checks.
impacts.agent: Only establishes that this QA API responded to the health request. Chat completion and answer quality need separate validation.
impacts.es: Checks whether a read-only news-index query completes with all shards successful.
impacts.crawler: Reads the most recent crawl report. Source coverage and article quality need separate measurements.
impacts.indexer: Reads the most recent embedding-job report. Failures and retries are not passes; vector completeness and model consistency need separate checks.
impacts.llm: Read actual QA model SDK outcomes from the last 15 minutes, including the fixed hourly dialogue. The success rate uses classified completions; cancellations and unclassified outcomes remain separate. Loading this page makes no model calls and does not assess answer quality.
impacts.collector: Collects query results and job records readable by the current QA instance.

reasons.not_connected: No probe source is connected for this component; health is unconfirmed.
reasons.api_responded: This QA API answered the health request. Chat and answer quality are not certified.
reasons.read_probe_ok: The read-only news query completed with every shard successful.
reasons.read_probe_failed: The news query did not fully succeed: timeout, partial failure or connection failure. Transport diagnostics are withheld.
reasons.collection_completed: The read-only collection completed without starting jobs or model calls.
reasons.job_reported: The job summary reported success with no known errors or pending retries.
reasons.job_failed: The job reported failure or still has errors/pending retries. Inspect the counts below.
reasons.old_artifact: The job report exceeded its freshness threshold. An old success does not establish current health.
reasons.missing_artifact: No read-only job summary was found. Connect the observation source to inspect this job.
reasons.invalid_artifact: The job summary is incomplete, corrupt or exceeds its read limit.
reasons.future_artifact: The job timestamp is ahead; its healthy claim is not accepted.
reasons.frontend_entry_ok: The QA entry returned its expected page identity and asset path within the deadline. JavaScript execution and interaction remain separate checks.
reasons.frontend_entry_failed: The QA entry failed its response check: connection, timeout, redirect or unexpected page. Private transport diagnostics are withheld.
reasons.invalid_probe_target: The configured QA entry cannot be verified. An operator must review the probe source; no request was sent.
reasons.llm_no_recent_requests: No usable completed model request was recorded in the last 15 minutes. This page makes no model calls and infers neither health nor failure from missing evidence.
reasons.llm_inconclusive: Recent records contain cancellations, unclassified outcomes or retention limits. They cannot establish complete provider health.
reasons.llm_requests_ok: All classifiable QA model requests in the last 15 minutes succeeded. Cancellations and unclassified outcomes are excluded from the rate; answer quality is assessed separately.
reasons.llm_requests_failed: Model requests failed, timed out or were rate limited in the last 15 minutes. Counts preserve each outcome without inferring a root cause.
reasons.llm_observation_unavailable: Model request observations are unavailable. Evidence from other releases or model configurations is not reused.

live.llmLimited: Recent records exceeded the retention limit. Only retained observations are shown; health remains inconclusive.

history.title: Observation history
history.unavailable: History is unavailable. Live observations remain independent.
history.schedule: Sampled every 5 minutes, retained for 7 days.
history.accumulating: Waiting for scheduled samples. Unmeasured periods are not backfilled.
history.chart: Historical measurements and sampled status timeline
history.gaps: The line uses the latest metric and unit. The strip shows each sampled status. Missing or stale samples and version or measurement contract changes remain gaps. Times are UTC+8.
history.unmeasured: This interval has no valid measurements. Recorded states are retained; unmeasured records do not form a numeric trend.
history.single: Only one valid measurement is available. More observations are needed for a trend.
history.tableNote: Latest 100 samples; the chart covers the full selected range.
history.sourceNotConnected: This module has no connected probe. These are unmeasured state records; waiting will not create a numeric trend or establish a service failure.
history.invalidSource: An operator must review the entry probe source. It currently produces no valid measurements; recorded states remain available below.
history.waitingForFrontendSample: The entry probe has a current result. Await the scheduled history sample; earlier unmeasured records are preserved.
history.missed: {count} sampling slots missing in this range.
history.since: Counted from the first record at {time}, allowing one minute for sampling to finish.
history.samplingScope: Sampling delays and component failures are assessed separately. Missing slots stay empty and are never backfilled.

samplerOutcomes.lock_busy: Previous sample deferred because the operations lock was busy
samplerOutcomes.failed: Previous sampling attempt failed; component state still uses actual observations

history.waitingForLlmRequest: No recent model measurements can be plotted. Records are added only after actual requests; no model is called to populate a chart. Earlier states remain available.
